[[Pelican Town]] |Time = 10:00 am - 5:00 pm |Season = {{Season|Spring}} |Weather = Sunny |Difficulty = 25 |Behavior = Dart |Size = 1 - 4 |XP = 12 |Edibility = 9 |base = 80 |Roe = yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can be caught at the river in [[Blue Moon Vineyard]] and [[Pelican Town]] during a sunny Spring day from 10 am - 5pm. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Blue Moon Vineyard.png|center|400px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Pelican Town.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Blue Moon Vineyard - Fish Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Pelican Town - Fish Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |love=Jas |neutral=Demetrius, Elliott, Linus, Pam, Sebastian, Willy |hate=Evelyn, Haley, Martin, Pierre, Sophia }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Goldfish}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes but can be used in recipes calling for "Any Fish." ==Bundles== When '''"SVE Bundles"''' is selected in the [[Configuration Options]], {{PAGENAME}} is used to complete the {{Bundle|River Fish|32|y}}. When '''"Hard SVE Bundles"''' is selected, 3 Goldfish are required to complete the bundle. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|orange}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces an orange color. {{Navbox Fish}} [[Category:Fish]] [[zh:金鱼]]
